name: Telegram Desktop
description: Auto downloads, verifies RSA-1024/SHA-1 vs PEM keys pinned in config.h, silently installs on restart. Weak crypto but pinned.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: This Telegram Desktop snapshot verifies update metadata with an embedded root Ed25519 key and manifest-controlled Ed25519/ES256 keys; release-channel coverage and restart installation behavior require separate evidence. The presence of this verifier does not by itself disprove an older RSA update path; release and caller mapping remain unresolved.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; released artifact behavior may differ.

original_evidence.text: | Telegram Desktop | telegramdesktop/tdesktop | Qt/C++ native | Y | auto (chk/dl/inst — installs silently on next app start, no click required beyond restart) | Y | https (QNetworkRequest to `https://td.telegram.org/current[N]`, default `AutoupdatePrefix`) | N (version-manifest is plain JSON, not signed itself) | signature (RSA-1024 + SHA-1, `RSA_verify(NID_sha1, ...)` over the whole compressed/LZMA update blob; SHA-1 digest of payload also checked before RSA verify) | pinned-in-binary (two PEM RSA public keys, `UpdatesPublicKey` / `UpdatesPublicBetaKey`, hardcoded literals) | `Telegram/SourceFiles/core/update_checker.cpp:369-405` (RSA verify, `hSigLen=128`⇒1024-bit key, `NID_sha1`); keys at `Telegram/SourceFiles/config.h:45-59`; default host `Telegram/SourceFiles/storage/localstorage.cpp:557` (`AutoupdatePrefix("https://td.telegram.org")`); auto-install gate `Telegram/SourceFiles/core/sandbox.cpp:426-431` (`Core::checkReadyUpdate()` → `cSetRestartingUpdate(true)` → quits and launches updater without prompting if `cAutoUpdate()` is on, default) |
